title: Arizona Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Arizona Taiwanese Student Association (ATSA) is a registered student organization at the University of Arizona in Tucson. According to its official campus directory listing, ATSA is a voluntary society devoted to discussions of culture and society in Taiwan, with a stated goal of engaging and educating the broader university community about Taiwan and Taiwanese culture.

The organization serves Taiwanese students studying in the United States by providing orientation support, consultation, and practical information to help members navigate campus life and the Tucson area. ATSA also emphasizes peer connection, working to link Taiwanese students abroad and help elevate their potential in an unfamiliar environment.

Beyond the campus level, ATSA seeks to engage with the local and national community, including other universities and Taiwan cultural centers. The organization appears in both the University of Arizona’s official campus groups portal and the Office of Multicultural Advancement’s listing of Asian Pacific American student clubs. An Instagram account (@ua_atsa) and a Facebook group (亞利桑那大學台灣學生會) are associated with the organization, though activity levels on those platforms could not be independently verified at the time of this writing.
